review_method: Labeled direction QA sheet visually inspected at normal size and zoom.

directions.observed: eyes point above the glasses line
directions.evidence: Eye gaze and tilted face point above horizontal.

directions.observed: head and gaze slightly up and screen-right
directions.evidence: Eye line points right and slightly up.
Nose and glasses angle to upper-right quadrant.

directions.observed: profile develops toward screen-right with slight upward angle
directions.evidence: Nose points screen-right; eyes are slightly elevated.
Nose and eye line point horizontally screen-right.
Nose remains to screen-right while gaze lowers.
Eye line slopes down toward screen-right.

directions.observed: head nearing downward cardinal from screen-right
directions.evidence: Nose remains just screen-right of center and gaze lowers.

directions.observed: face and eyes aimed at keyboard
directions.evidence: Nose and both eyes point down toward desk.
Nose moves screen-left while gaze stays below horizontal.

directions.observed: nose and gaze diagonally screen-left and down
directions.evidence: Glasses and nose angle to lower-left quadrant.

directions.observed: near screen-left profile with slight downward angle
directions.evidence: Nose points left with eyes slightly down.
Nose and eye line point horizontally screen-left.
Nose remains left while eyes lift above horizontal.
Nose and glasses angle to upper-left quadrant.

directions.observed: head nearing upward cardinal from screen-left
directions.evidence: Nose approaches center from screen-left with gaze up.
